description: Use this when the person asks about the products in their own ProofPass account, or a product id is needed for another account tool. Lists the products of the connected ProofPass account (also those not public) with id, article number, GTIN, whether they are public and how many current documents they hold; optionally only those matching a search word. Use first to find a product id. Do not use for products of other manufacturers (use search_products).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

query.description: Part of the name, article number, GTIN or UFI

name: list_my_products
title: List my products
